content:
ops-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: metric=streamer.contbatch.p99 latency_usw2 > 2200ms for 12m. severity=high. runbook=/runbooks/stream-tail-latency

mira: paging eng-oncall — seeing p99 ~2300ms, p95 ~850ms. spike correlates to gpu-prod-usw2-3 pool. no 5xxs so far, but streaming sessions stall >10s. assigning @taylan to lead mitigation.

taylan: ack. pulling scheduler + batching metrics. initial look: batch sizes jumped, lots of mixed seqlen packs, KV-cache churn. suspect cont-batch packer changed behavior after last scheduler tweak.

sam: can we cap batch size quickly? small repro on staging showed big p99 when batch > 1024 tokens. proposing set max_tokens=256 for pool.

mira: good. if we can flip that quickly we'll know if it's batching packing. also consider disabling continuous batching on this pool as fallback.

taylan: rolling a config patch to cap batch size now. command:```bash
redwoodctl pools update gpu-prod-usw2-3 --set batch.max_tokens=256 --reason "live cont-batch p99 mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for pool gpu-prod-usw2-3 -> updating nodes 0..9 (10 nodes)

lina: CS check — customers telemetry shows elevated input-to-first-token latency for two customers (acme-inc, betaapp) on us-west-2 streaming routes. no HTTP 5xxs, just long stalls causing UX hangs. customer outreach queued if we need longer mitigation.

taylan: cap applied to 6/10 nodes, metrics deck shows p99 dropping on those nodes by ~900ms already. continuing rollout.

mira: good signal. can we also hold any recent scheduler PRs? @repo-bot was there a recent change?

taylan: yes there was a packer heuristic tweak merged 2h ago. I'll create a quick revert PR to stop further rollouts.

deploy-bot: rollout completed 10/10 nodes. patch id=rb-2026-4248.

ops-bot: ALERT update: stream_tail_latency_p99_us-west-2 reduced from 2320ms -> 720ms over 8m after cap. SLO breach window closing.

sam: as follow-up we should disable continuous batching on the pool for a longer window while we dig into mixed-seqlen behavior. command to toggle:```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap batcher-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/continuous_batching","value":"false"}]'
```

taylan: toggled continuous batching off (confirmed on leader). p99 stabilized ~650ms, p95 ~420ms. nice.

lina: marking customers impacted: acme-inc, betaapp. CS will send FYI that we observed stalls but no request errors; mitigation in place.

mira: handoff — I need to rotate to next shift in 30m. @jess you on-night? please follow up with postmortem and ensure regression alert added.

jess: taking handoff. will open INC-2026-184, add timeline, collect packer logs, batch size histograms, and model KV eviction traces. also will create a permanent alert: contbatch.p99 > 1s for 5m.

mira: thanks. action items before handoff: (1) keep continuous batching off for 2h, (2) revert recent packer heuristic PR, (3) run two controlled canaries with mixed-seqlen traffic driving batcher to observe packing behavior, (4) correlate KV-cache evictions and batch growth.

taylan: noted. I'll post the revert PR link + canary plan in the incident ticket.

ops-bot: NOTE: next automated customer notification window in 60m.

jess: acknowledged, will monitor metrics and start writeup. closing on-call chat — followups in INC-2026-184 and repo PRs. :white_check_mark:
